sources.title: GitHub - SammyOina/cube: Cube AI - LLM protection with TEEs
sources.snippet: Cube AI is a framework for building GPT-based AI applications using confidential computing. It protects user data and the AI model by using a trusted execution environment (TEE). TEE is a secure area of a processor that ensures that code and data loaded inside it are protected with respect to confidentiality and integrity.
